Invitation

/app/invitations/:invitationId
Roles: guest, student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: P42

Let the intended recipient review and accept a specific academic role invitation. An invitation remains a proposal until correct-account acceptance succeeds.

Keep reviewingAccept invitation
Permissions
  • Only matching recipient sees full invitation facts.
  • Course invitation cannot grant institution administration or unrelated course access.
  • TA acceptance grants allocated scope, never policy or release authority.
Responsive
  • Role and expiry facts stack before the primary action.
  • Long recipient addresses wrap; no clipped mismatch warning.
Accessibility
  • Use a definition list for role facts and a visible checkbox label.
  • Acceptance error links focus the checkbox or identity recovery action.
Data
  • Invitation fixture: masked recipient, inviter, course, role, scope, expiry, status.
  • Existing membership status distinguishes invited from active.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Wrong-account view cannot expose full recipient address or learner records.
  • An expired invitation cannot be accepted after a stale page is left open.
  • Double activation produces one accepted result and one existing-access view.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
